user_saw: During a Gateway restart or update the Control UI showed only a small connection indicator, which made planned downtime look like a broken page.
summary: Adds a Control UI connection/holding view during Gateway startup and reconnection that keeps the shell and drafts, a self-retrying asset-free recovery page when the app document is unavailable, and manual recovery actions after automatic recovery stops.
reasoning: The linked issue #191925 is a feature/improvement request ('Improve Gateway downtime holding and retry guidance') that states current source already retains the loaded Control UI and reconnects; the problem it names is presentation that makes downtime look broken, not a failure introduced by a commit. The PR is a large new presentation and availability surface (new control-ui-availability.ts, new connection view, branding assets), so it is a product/UX improvement titled as a fix; blame candidates are Solid migrations that merely last touched the replaced shell code.
